models.Hillel: The calculated Jewish calendar used for shared observance today. Its months are lunar and leap months keep the year aligned with the seasons.
models.Enochian: A 364-day solar model associated with 1 Enoch and calendar traditions represented among the Dead Sea Scrolls. This card presents one project reference schedule.
models.Zedokian: A project label for priestly-calendar reconstructions associated with Zadok traditions. There is no single agreed modern reconstruction.

passover.title: Passover
passover.body: Passover remembers deliverance from bondage in Egypt. Scripture centers remembrance, retelling, and the marking of deliverance.

unleavened_bread.title: Feast of Unleavened Bread
unleavened_bread.body: This feast follows Passover, remembering Israel's hurried departure and the removal of leaven.

first_fruits.title: First Fruits
first_fruits.body: First Fruits marks the beginning of harvest through gratitude, offering, and the promise of more to come.

pentecost.title: Pentecost / Shavuot
pentecost.body: Shavuot comes after the counting of weeks and is associated with harvest; Acts connects Pentecost with the giving of the Spirit.

trumpets.title: Trumpets / Yom Teruah
trumpets.body: Scripture appoints a day of rest and trumpet blasts, calling the assembly to attention and remembrance.

atonement.title: Day of Atonement / Yom Kippur
atonement.body: A solemn appointed day centered on atonement, humility, cleansing, and rest.

tabernacles.title: Tabernacles / Sukkot
tabernacles.body: Sukkot remembers dwelling in temporary shelters and carries themes of joy, provision, dependence, and God dwelling with His people.

events: A night of remembrance, deliverance, and freedom.
Leaving bondage behind and walking in a new way.
The beginning of harvest and the promise of more to come.
Weeks counted, harvest celebrated, and the Spirit given in Acts.
A day of rest, trumpet blasts, remembrance, and gathering.
Atonement, humility, cleansing, mercy, and rest.
Dwelling, joy, provision, and wilderness remembrance.

KIPPUR.title: Yom Kippur
KIPPUR.meditationText: Create in me a clean heart.

daily.title: Dwelling in Joy
daily.text: God is present among His people.

Chesed.title: Mercy / Lovingkindness
Chesed.meditation: Where can I become more generous, gentle, and open-hearted today?
Chesed.prayer: Teach me to give freely without pride, fear, or self-seeking.
Chesed.scripture: Let all that you do be done in love.

Gevurah.title: Strength / Discipline
Gevurah.meditation: What needs restraint, order, honesty, or holy boundaries in my life today?
Gevurah.prayer: Give me courage to say yes to what is right and no to what weakens my soul.

Tiferet.title: Beauty / Compassion / Harmony
Tiferet.meditation: How can truth and mercy meet in the way I speak, judge, and respond today?
Tiferet.prayer: Balance zeal with tenderness, and conviction with compassion.
Tiferet.scripture: What does the Lord require of you but to do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly?

Netzach.title: Endurance / Victory
Netzach.meditation: Where must I keep going faithfully, even if progress feels slow?
Netzach.prayer: Strengthen me to endure with hope, patience, and steadiness.
Netzach.scripture: Let us not grow weary in well-doing.

Hod.title: Humility / Splendor
Hod.meditation: Where do I need humility, gratitude, and the grace to listen today?
Hod.prayer: Deliver me from vanity and teach me the beauty of surrender.
Hod.scripture: God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

Yesod.title: Foundation / Bonding
Yesod.meditation: What relationships, habits, and commitments need to be strengthened at the root?
Yesod.prayer: Establish me in faithfulness, integrity, and covenant love.
Yesod.scripture: The righteous shall never be removed.

Malchut.title: Kingdom / Presence / Noble Action
Malchut.meditation: How can what is within me become real in the world through action, leadership, and presence?
Malchut.prayer: Let what You build in me become fruitful in the world around me.
Malchut.scripture: Your kingdom come. Your will be done.

prepare.title: Prepare Your Heart
prepare.text: The count has not yet begun. Use this time to quiet your heart, make room, and prepare for the journey.
prepare.prayer: Prayer: Ready me for the discipline, beauty, and transformation of these coming days.

complete.title: Completion
complete.text: The Omer journey is complete. Look back over the path, remember what was purified, strengthened, and revealed.
complete.prayer: Prayer: Seal in me what You have grown during these days, and let it bear fruit beyond this season.
complete.scripture: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.
